[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

1. **“Dost” = Sameer khud.** Transcript se: woh “isi mahine move” karna chahta hai, “group mein zikr mat karna” kehta hai kyunki woh private rakhta hai, aur baad mein Faisal usi “dost” ka CV maangta hai — Sameer gayab. **Third-person costume** uske “expanding soon boys” / Dubai lifestyle image ko bachata hai; agar group ko pata chale ki woh 15-18 LPA job dhoondh raha hai toh “business boom” ka mask gir jayega. Isliye “dost” ka fiction deniability deta hai.

2. **Group message ne Sameer ko public mein pin kar diya.** Faisal ne reunion sponsor waale joke se uske “business boom” claim ko highlight kiya (Tushar: “gym king”). Sameer ne sirf **👍** bheja — na inkaar, na explanation; face-save kiya. Uske baad DM mein CV maanga gaya toh **teen din silence + “hello? bhai?”** — kyunki ab woh admit nahi kar sakta ki “dost” wohi hai, aur group tease ke baad private request awkward ho gayi. Thumbs-up = acknowledgment; joke = exposure; silence = escape.

3. **Faisal ka DM (bilkul waisa bhejna chahiye):**
> “Bhai CV bhej de dost ka — HR wait kar rahi hai. Aur haan, group waala sponsor joke alag tha, yeh toh private kaam hai na? Tera thumbs-up dekh ke laga tu cool hai isse. Bhej de, main cover kar lunga, kisi ko pata nahi chalega. 👍”

Yeh Sameer ko “dost” frame mein hi help karne ko majboor karta hai, bina usse khud confess karwaye; group joke aur thumbs-up dono recall karke guilt/obligation trigger karta hai, aur “private” promise uski image bachata hai.
